profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Building things for the web has been a passion of mine for a little over fifteen years, sparked at the age of 13 by the simple task of customizing the appearance of my blog. I was captivated by the process and was quickly drawn in, eager to learn and expand my knowledge. 

Over the years I’ve gained experience in a wide range of technologies, having an advanced understanding of client-side languages like modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the browser, as well proficiency with many server-side technologies (primarily server-side JavaScript and web application frameworks and MongoDB) and building macOS/iOS apps using Swift and SwiftUI. 

In addition to my knowledge of the aforementioned topics, I have experience with PHP, MySQL, server administration, Microsoft Access, AWS, and integrating APIs, and am familiar with much more — I am always eager to expand my knowledge and am excited to build great software.

The work I've been responsible for runs the gamut from simple static business websites to full proprietary data management systems with heavy mobile components. My professional experience also includes varying levels of graphic design, including brand creation and UI/UX design, usually tied to development projects I led or was involved in.

projects.title: Junction
projects.description: Junction is to be a software distribution platform for media production applications, initially targeting digital audio workstations, plugins, and sound packages, with integrated and centralized licensing and rights management for content providers. The platform also aims to include basic social networking and support functionality to help facilitate a richer connection between users and developers/publishers.
